**Coca-Cola** had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2025, by roughly 23 percentage points. The Walmart figures are from its filing, but the Coca-Cola figures are my estimate from memory, so the gap is approximate.

- **Walmart (fiscal year ended Jan 31, 2025):** operating income of about $29.3B on revenue of about $681.0B gives a margin of about 4.3%.
- **Coca-Cola (fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025):** I estimate operating income of about $13.0B on revenue of about $47.9B, a margin of about 27%.

Gap: 27.3% − 4.3% ≈ 23 percentage points.
